# Vendored reader libraries

| File | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `djvu.js` | [DjVu.js](https://github.com/RussCoder/djvujs) 0.5.4, `library/` built at commit eca3e69 | GPL-2.0-or-later (`djvu.LICENSE`) |
| `unrar.js`, `unrar.wasm` | [node-unrar-js](https://github.com/YuJianrong/node-unrar.js) 2.0.2, bundled for the browser with esbuild | MIT wrapper (`unrar.LICENSE`); it compiles RARLAB's UnRAR source, which is freeware for extracting archives |

This app is for personal use and is not distributed, so the GPL terms of DjVu.js are not triggered.
